turns.content: I had a follow-up appointment with Dr. Lee, the dermatologist, after a benign biopsy.
Dr. Smith prescribed antibiotics after the urinary tract infection.
I will remember the separate doctor context.
I was diagnosed with chronic sinusitis by Dr. Patel, the ENT specialist, and she prescribed a nasal spray.
I will keep Dr. Patel associated with the chronic sinusitis diagnosis and nasal spray.
I bought a smoker today for BBQ experiments with hickory and apple wood.
Nice, that smoker context may matter for future BBQ questions.
Noise: my neighbor Lee bought a toaster, and Smith Street has a clinic, but neither is one of my doctors.
I will keep that as noise rather than doctor context.
